name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: File acquisition surface — drop, click-to-browse, and paste — as a thin shell over use-file-drop; the surface is the named focusable control over a hidden picker-bridge input; data-dragging/data-drag-invalid styling flags.

meta.whenToUse: A visible upload surface — drop files, click to browse, paste — that hands accepted File[]s to the host and typed rejections back.
meta.whenNotToUse: Chrome-less acquisition inside another surface (compose use-file-drop directly) or rendering upload progress (Attachment).
